description: This file defines the EmployeeEvent entity class, which maps to the 'ohrm_employee_event' database table. It models events related to employees within the Human Resource Management system, including event types, event actions, and associated metadata such as timestamps and notes.

classes.name: EmployeeEvent
classes.description: Represents employee-related events with fields for event details, timestamps, and metadata, linked to a database table via Doctrine ORM annotations.

methods.name: getEventId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the event.

methods.name: setEventId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the event.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with this event.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number associated with this event.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the event.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of the event.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns the note associated with the event.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets the note associated with the event.

methods.name: getCreatedDate
methods.description: Returns the date and time when the event was created.

methods.name: setCreatedDate
methods.description: Sets the creation date of the event.

methods.name: getCreatedBy
methods.description: Returns the creator of the event record.

methods.name: setCreatedBy
methods.description: Sets the creator of the event record.
